title: Per-input evaluation spec (spec.json)
description: AUTHORED BY THE EVALUATION/BENCHMARK SIDE (not emitted by Artemis). Lives at corpus/inputs/<input_id>/spec.json. Supplies the reference information the deterministic metrics need: required constructs (#6), complexity band (#7), rule-based item-writing rules (#12), and the optional golden reference (#9/#10/#11).

input_id.description: SHOULD equal the containing directory name; referenced by candidate records and attempt logs.

source.description: Provenance of the underlying assignment (e.g. 'ITP', 'PSE', 'KIT'); used for the contamination discussion.

brief_path.description: Optional path (relative to this input directory) to the instructor brief used as the generation input.

golden_ref.description: Optional path (relative to this input directory) to the vetted golden exercise, in the same Maven/Ares format. Enables #9/#10/#11; omit or null if none.

required_constructs.description: Constructs metric #6 (concept fidelity) asserts via AST/SCA. The 'kind' vocabulary is extensible (open decision); initial kinds: loop, no_loop, recursion, no_recursion, conditional, method, class, interface, inheritance, generics, exception_handling, collection, array, stream, lambda.

complexity_band.description: Acceptable complexity ranges for metric #7 (applied to the solution's methods). Standard keys cyclomatic/cognitive; other named metrics allowed with the same range shape.

item_writing_rules.description: Rule IDs for the deterministic subset of metric #12. Extensible; initial IDs: no_answer_in_graded_test, statement_test_agreement, no_negation_in_statement, single_public_class, no_todo_left_in_template.

required_constructs.description: no for/while loops in the solution
